senses.gloss: चुचि m. (-चिः) The female breast or bosom.

चुचुक mn. (-कः-कं) A nipple.
 E. चुष् to suck, and क affix, deriv. irr. or

चूचुक mn. (-कः-कं) A nipple.
 E. चूष् to suck, and deriv. irr.; or चूचु
imitative sound, (in sucking) and क what makes; also चुचुक, &c.
चूष्यते चूष वा उकः पृषो-षस्य च । कुचाग्रे ।

चुचु imitative sound, (such as a child makes in sucking,) and क
[]
what sounds; also चुचूक and चूचुक; चुचु इति अव्यक्तशब्दं कायति पीयमानः
कै-क ।
चुचू m. (-चूः) A potherb, (Marsilea dentata, Rox.)

चुच्य (ई) चुच्यी r. 1st cl. (चुच्यति)
 1. To distil, to drop.
 2. To bathe. भ्वा-पर-सक ।
